exam.name: NVIDIA-Certified Professional: Agentic AI LLMs
exam.passing_score_note: NVIDIA does not publish the cut score. Community reports cluster around 70-75%. This simulator defaults to 75% so you train with margin.
exam.weights_note: NVIDIA's published percentages sum to 98%. The simulator normalizes them to 100% when building an exam.

domains.name: Agent Architecture and Design
domains.scope: Structuring agents, interaction patterns, reasoning loops, and communication within environments. Single vs. multi-agent topologies, orchestration patterns, tool/function interfaces, protocols (MCP, A2A), state machines vs. free-form loops, failure isolation.

domains.name: Agent Development
domains.scope: Building, integrating, and enhancing agents. Frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, NeMo Agent Toolkit), tool definition and schemas, structured output, prompt engineering for agents, error handling and retries, function-calling models, testing agents.

domains.name: Evaluation and Tuning
domains.scope: Measuring, comparing, and optimizing agent performance. Trajectory vs. outcome evaluation, LLM-as-judge, RAG metrics (faithfulness, context recall/precision, answer relevance), benchmarks, A/B testing, PEFT/LoRA/SFT/DPO vs. prompt or retrieval fixes, RAGAS, NeMo Evaluator.

domains.name: Deployment and Scaling
domains.scope: Operationalizing and scaling agentic systems. Inference serving (TensorRT-LLM, Triton, vLLM, NIM), batching, KV cache, quantization, parallelism (TP/PP/EP), autoscaling, latency/throughput trade-offs, Kubernetes/Dynamo, cost per token.

domains.name: Cognition, Planning, and Memory
domains.scope: Reasoning, decision-making, and memory management. CoT/ToT/ReAct/Reflexion, planner-executor split, task decomposition, short vs. long-term memory, episodic/semantic/procedural memory, context window management, summarization/compaction, reasoning models and test-time compute.

domains.name: Knowledge Integration and Data Handling
domains.scope: Integrating external knowledge and managing diverse data. Chunking, embeddings, vector/hybrid/graph retrieval, rerankers, query rewriting, multimodal ingestion, freshness and invalidation, PII handling in pipelines, NeMo Retriever, cuVS/cuDF acceleration.

domains.name: NVIDIA Platform Implementation
domains.scope: Choosing and using NVIDIA hardware and software. NIM microservices, NeMo (Curator/Customizer/Evaluator/Guardrails/Retriever), NeMo Agent Toolkit, TensorRT-LLM, Triton, Dynamo, RAPIDS, build.nvidia.com, AI Blueprints, GPU selection (H100/H200/GB200, NVLink, MIG), DGX/EGX.
domains.note: Small weight but highest density of memorizable facts. Over-study this domain.

domains.name: Run, Monitor, and Maintain
domains.scope: Post-deployment operations. Tracing/observability (OpenTelemetry, spans over agent steps), token and cost telemetry, drift detection, incident response, canary and rollback, versioning prompts/tools/models, SLOs for agents, profiling.

domains.name: Safety, Ethics, and Compliance
domains.scope: Responsible AI and regulation. Guardrails (input/output/dialog/retrieval rails), prompt injection and tool-poisoning defenses, least-privilege tool scopes, jailbreak detection, EU AI Act risk tiers, NIST AI RMF, data residency, audit trails, bias and transparency.

domains.name: Human-AI Interaction and Oversight
domains.scope: Designing human oversight. Human-in-the-loop vs. on-the-loop, approval gates and interrupts, confidence-based escalation, uncertainty surfacing, undo/compensating actions, explainability to end users, feedback capture and preference data, handoff design.
